messages:
Marta: Heads-up on Amarok14b int4 bring-up — seeing a perf+quality regression on codegen-long suite and occasional OOMs at batch=4.
Sachin: Can you drop the numbers and config?
Marta: quick numbers: p50 +12% latency vs fp16 baseline, tokens/sec -18%, and a few OOM traces. Repro config:
```
model: amarok-14b-int4
batch_size: 4
max_new_tokens: 256
kv_prefetch: true
slot_reserve: 0.05
```
Eli: Logs show KV cache churn and fragmentation spikes around allocation ~2.1GB, looks like double-mapped pages when prefetch on.
perf-bot: Canary run 2026-02-11T03:12Z - quality gate FAILED (codegen-long: rouge delta -3.2).
Marta: Reran with batch=2, max_new_tokens=128 -> no OOM, latency improved, but codegen quality still below baseline.
Sachin: Try disabling kv_prefetch and bump slot_reserve to 0.12, maybe avoid thrash.
Marta: did that, batch=4 + kv_prefetch=false + slot_reserve=0.12 -> no OOM, p50 comparable, quality in between fp16 and int4.
Eli: Hypothesis: quant kernel selection picks slower matmul path for certain seq lengths and prefetch triggers an extra KV allocation path -> fragmentation. Also prefetch+small slot_reserve can create duplicate allocations.
QA-lab: Full eval (500 samples) shows exact-match drop ~6% on completion tasks vs fp16 baseline. Nontrivial regression.
Marta: Proposed plan: 1) revert default batch for amarok-int4 to 2 in model defaults; 2) change max_new_tokens default to 128 for this model class; 3) add post-quant evaluation gating specifically for codegen-long; 4) runtime patch to avoid duplicate KV allocations when prefetch + slot_reserve present.
Sachin: +1 to plan. Also add automatic fallback to fp16 for heavy-codegen flows once quality gate fails.
Eli: I'll open runtime PR with alloc traces and microbench harness to reproduce kernel selection behavior.
Marta: Filed ticket: https://redwood/issue/AM-3129 (canary + model-defaults).
triage-bot: created incident AM-3129, assignees: eli, marta.
eng-runtime: saw this thread, prioritizing kernel path selection and alloc dedupe.
QA-lab: will re-run full codegen-long eval after PR lands and report metrics.
Marta: planning to roll canary change (batch default -> 2) later today for limited traffic :eyes:
Sachin: please add a 'kv-frag' console metric so we can alert on fragmentation spikes.
Marta: good call, added to ticket.
Eli: quick note: for immediate mitigation we can set a runtime heuristic to prefer fp16 kernels for seqs >1024 or workloads flagged as codegen. That avoids quality regressions while we fix int4 path.
Marta: thanks — that's a good short-term fallback.
Sachin: also logging suggestion: include quant-kernel id in request traces so perf teams can filter.
Marta: ack, will add to canary checklist.
QA-lab: tagging @eng-runtime and @perf-bot for follow-ups.
Marta: thanks all, I'll post canary results in this thread once done. :thumbsup:
